name: Harpoon Launcher
look: a short brass harpoon-gun barrel with a barbed steel harpoon loaded in it and a coiled chain wrapped along the side

name: Rifled Barrel
look: a long blued-steel barrel with brass bands and small cut-away windows showing spiral rifling inside

name: Coil Accelerator
effect: Next to a Harpoon Launcher: Harpoon Shot becomes Shock Harpoon.
look: a short tube wrapped in stacked copper coil rings, thin blue electric arcs jumping between the rings

name: Flame Nozzle
look: an angled heat-blued nozzle with a tiny pilot flame, a small round fuel tank and a spark igniter with a blue glow

name: Net Caster
effect: On capture contracts adds card: Iron Net.
look: a wide-mouthed launcher tube with a folded iron-wire net and small lead weights sticking out of its mouth

name: Brass Scope
effect: Shots at body parts deal +3 damage.
look: a long brass telescopic sight with adjustment knobs and a lens that faintly shows a crosshair

name: Lantern Lens
look: a small round lens in a brass ring with a tiny caged electric bulb glowing behind it

name: Eye of the Hound
effect: Start of the fight: see the creature's next moves.
look: a preserved yellow beast eye floating in a glass sphere with a brass rim, thin red veins in the liquid

name: Drum Magazine
look: a round riveted drum magazine with a small window showing rows of brass cartridges

name: Quick Loader
look: a spring-loaded speed-loader clip holding a neat row of brass cartridges

name: Ichor Cartridges
look: glass-bodied cartridges filled with dark red ichor, held in a stained leather bandolier strip

name: Capacitor Bank
look: three glass capacitor jars with copper caps linked by braided cables, a cold blue glow inside

name: Recoil Spring
look: a heavy coiled spring assembly with two pistons, brass end caps and oily steel guides

name: Bayonet Mount
look: a folding steel bayonet blade on a hinged mount with a locking lever

name: Bone Brace
look: carved bone struts lashed together with sinew and iron wire, old dark blood stains in the cracks

name: Gyro Stabilizer
look: nested gyroscope rings spinning inside a brass cage on a steel base

name: Galvanic Core
look: a cylindrical battery core in an iron cage with captured lightning crawling inside thick glass

name: Vein Lattice
effect: Blood modules touching it get a stronger effect.
look: a lattice of glass tubes with dark red fluid pumping through them, small brass valves, like a mechanical vein

name: Serrated Rail
look: a steel rail with a saw-tooth blade along its length and small rivets

name: Smoke Vent
look: small leather bellows connected to sooty vent pipes, a thin puff of grey smoke
